title: Research: exclude three larger-simplex P112 beta shapes
body:
## Summary

Exclude the P112 weight shape `2,5^3,6^b` in each pinned TWOSIDE cell `(b,t)=(6,4),(7,4),(8,4)`, over every characteristic-zero field.

```text
Three small pieces, support union <= 26
  quotient normalization gives b+1 root-simplex vertices
  coordinate incidence cap = 12,16,20
  required inequalities = 801<=792, 1068<=1064, 1388<=1376
```

Only `research/p112-larger-root-simplices/` is added. It contains the proof, exact sources, registered checker, finite evidence, controls and reproduction instructions. Final commit `182168c4a7af570902b231aa6d35bbf4139098f2`; base main `997e6a9ca7b4f95d50e366f61412fd640d72a88a`, priority revision 6. [Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/3156#discussioncomment-18999460).

Credit DreamingOfClouds/#3154 at `708f0ad8928c383de8294aea3c126e9461d2066d` for TWOSIDE and the handoff; Nick Petalas/#3164 at `857384079ab640a949fb7618b7909664d3e737e5` for the six-vertex predecessor and retained geometry; and the retained E8/P112 decoder lineage. #3167 is an audited weight-cover overlap control. Concurrent #3169 at `b859f7791a6d2dad68652d5a54e266cb020a1302` concerns five distinct `(5,5)` shapes and a stronger six-vertex coordinate budget. Its PR was read, not cold-replayed here. Development and local checking used substantial automated assistance.

## Evidence

- **Before:** the exact original source retains these shapes in cells with `69,154,251` survivors. Their weight-certified quotient covers need fourteen separate deletions, with no nonbasis rank-four anchor, outside the earlier eight-/ten-deletion and rank-four/twelve-deletion acceptance rules.
- **After:** the larger-simplex proof excludes them with exact margins **9, 4, 12**. Increasing the allowed small-support union by one removes each contradiction, retained as a failure control.
- Full replay covers 4,097,782 flat kernels, all 7,140 root planes, 960 reflections and the original 24-cell table. Fifteen behavioral groups include strict cutoffs, source/input/receipt mutants, independent rational fixture ranks and exhaustive two-level incidence assignments.
- Registered Python 3.12 replay, optimized Python 3.13 equality, read-only Git-free export, Ruff and warnings-as-errors compilation pass locally. All eighteen committed package/input byte comparisons pass.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-larger-root-simplices
```

This closes three named piece configurations, not complete cells, full C5, `C(P112)>=64`, supplier admission or a new kappa. The standard Weyl-chamber theorem and replayed finite geometry are used. Independent human/proof-kernel review and hosted CI remain separate. The selected frontier is unchanged. Open next questions and bounded implementation deviations are recorded in the package.

## Merge danger

**Door:** two-way.

**Blast radius:** research.

One isolated opt-in proof package. No shared code, selected-result or frozen-input edits.
